bead.title: Update contract and capability docs for fiz harness identity
bead.description: Update CONTRACT-003 and the primary harness capability baseline so the native Fizeau harness is named fiz, and reserve agent for real external AI-agent concepts or historical references that cannot be changed safely. Keep the wording aligned with the new identity but do not expand unrelated spec content.
bead.acceptance: 1. CONTRACT-003 documents fiz as the native Fizeau harness identity. 2. CONTRACT-003 states agent is reserved for real external AI-agent concepts, not the native Fizeau route. 3. primary-harness-capability-baseline.md uses fiz for the native harness and no longer treats agent as the native identity in active contract prose.
